scope: Retained v2 aggregate records. No simulation, fit, bootstrap or study was rerun. CSV payloads preserve their source text. Summaries use arithmetic over the retained aggregate records.
interpretation: These are retrospective conditional simulator results. Cells share price histories and candidates. Counts are not independent replication. No population confidence guarantee is established.

source_limits.v2_mechanism_ls1.csv: Only pool A/B/C/D primary and fold rows support the present four-pool claims. ALPHA rows are retained for completeness but are not used.
source_limits.v2_mechanism_ls1.json: Use primary and four-pool fold summaries only. The alpha summary is not used.
source_limits.v2_tercilesls1.csv: Retained subgroup outputs. All three companion raw files have marked-to-market metadata. Tercile assignment uses full-panel liquidity and is retrospective.
source_limits.v2_simfree_ls1.csv: Universe volatility, liquidity and name-count summaries use the full stored panel. This rule is not a verified selection-window-only policy.
source_limits.v2_remedy_t1ls1_full.csv: Deflated net and net have close but unequal expected selected means. The aggregate values do not establish identical rankings or winners for every subset.

derived_summary.sign_convention: The paper uses Gamma=-D, Gamma_cap=-D_capacity_total and Gamma_cap=-D_capacity. Negation reverses interval endpoint order. Lambda_gross and gain keep their source signs.

stationary_bootstrap.pairing: same day counts across pools, candidates, and selectors
